description: 10 hand-worked questions spanning unseen_ios_24h_chat.txt (FestPass kiosk) and unseen_noisy_large_chat.txt (RoverX robotics build).

questions.question: How is badge printing being handled right now, and how did that decision change over time?
questions.expected_answer: Badge printing now uses a WiFi CUPS print server on Raspberry Pi (final decision on 22/08/2026, with Neha finishing the WiFi CUPS driver). Earlier the team chose Bluetooth thermal SDK (escpos-bt) on 10/08/2026, dropped it on 12/08/2026 because Bluetooth kept dropping and switched to USB OTG thermal bridge (usb-spooler), and then reversed to WiFi CUPS because USB OTG only allowed one tablet per printer across 3 check-in counters.

questions.question: When is the kiosk dry run scheduled, and what happened to the opening ceremony date?
questions.expected_answer: The kiosk dry run is scheduled for 17 Sep (4 days before the opening ceremony). The opening ceremony shifted from 18 Sep to 22 Sep, and was then corrected to a final date of 21 Sep because 22 Sep clashed with convocation rehearsal.

questions.question: Who took over the QR scanner module, is it finished, and is anything unassigned right now?
questions.expected_answer: Tanya took over the QR scanner module from Ananya (when it was 75% done on branch qr-v2) and finished and tagged it in v1.4. Volunteer roster sync is unassigned: Siddharth dropped it on 15/08/2026, nobody claimed it, and Vikram deferred assigning it to the 14 Sep planning call.

questions.question: Did Vikram finish the check-in analytics dashboard?
questions.expected_answer: The chat doesn't say whether Vikram finished the check-in analytics dashboard. Vikram owns it (assigned via 'I' in M011), missed an earlier 'kal tak' promise, and on 05/09/2026 said it was still pending with an ETA of 12 Sep before the chat ended on 10/09/2026.

questions.question: What was the admin WiFi password Vikram deleted on 29 Aug, and what was decided in the 14 Sep planning call?
What motor controller decision did the team finally make, how did it change over the 5 weeks, and who is handling its firmware?
questions.expected_answer: The team finally decided on VESC 6.0 CAN controllers (24/07/26), with Dev handling VESC firmware tuning (currently at bench calibration). Originally they chose L298N driver boards for prototype (02/07/26), dropped L298N on 10/07/26 after it overheated and burned at 4A and switched to BTS7960 43A H-bridge, and then scrapped BTS7960 when alumni donated VESC 6.0 CAN controllers.

questions.question: Who currently owns the telemetry radio link and sensor mast CAD, and are those tasks completed?
questions.expected_answer: Zoya currently owns the telemetry radio link and Ira owns sensor mast CAD after swapping on 18/07/26 (when Ira had telemetry radio link at 40% on lora-packets). Both tasks are completed: Zoya finished and range-tested the telemetry radio link at 400m, and Ira finished sensor mast CAD with STEP and STL files exported.

questions.question: When is the safety inspection video due, and what is the final date for regional qualifiers?
questions.expected_answer: The safety inspection video is due 30 Aug (5 days before regional qualifiers), and the confirmed final date for regional qualifiers is 4 Sep (after shifting from 30 Aug to tentative 6 Sep and then correcting to 4 Sep).

questions.question: Is any task unassigned, and did Kunal finish autonomous waypoint nav?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, soil moisture probe is unassigned: Tarun dropped it on 11/07/26, nobody claimed it, and Dev put it on the 7 Aug lab review agenda. No, Kunal did not finish autonomous waypoint nav: after broken ETAs, as of 05/08/26 PID tuning is 65% done and obstacle avoidance is still remaining.
